newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets await direction from U.S.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets await direction from U.S.

text.p: Europe's raw cotton markets were neglected on Monday in the absence of fresh price indications from the New York futures exchange, industry sources said.

Some sellers reported buying interest in low grade Argentinian and Indian cottons but there were few firm trades in any sector, they said. The long-standing dearth of market-moving fundamental news and evidence that regular buyers in Portugal, France, Italy and Belgium have largely covered their requirements for March indicates that the market is set to remain quiet in the near-term, they said.
